paragraphs: Hyman places him in Rav Chisda’s time, as in Ketubot 27b; see also the entry Mari bar Isak.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Ketubot 27b paragraph gives Mari bar Isak with the alternative Chana bar Isak and an appearance before Rav Chisda. Hyman’s chronological placement is retained with attribution, and the Mari pointer stays unbound; no date, genealogical claim, or extra narrative detail is imported.
